duviri-repast-table.description: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.

duviri-scales.name: Duviri Scales
duviri-scales.description: Used to weigh out meager, everyday goods by meager, everyday merchants.

duviri-senate-seat.name: Duviri Senate Seat
duviri-senate-seat.description: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.

duviri-shrub.name: Duviri Shrub
duviri-shrub.description: A leafy shrub created in imitation of the flora described in Tales of Duviri.

duviri-theater-seat.name: Duviri Theater Seat
duviri-theater-seat.description: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine's performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.

duviri-thermos.name: Duviri Thermos
duviri-thermos.description: The ideal vessel for any Tammherd who enjoys a hot or cold drink on the job.

dvad-luxxum-ornament.name: Dvad Luxxum Ornament
dvad-luxxum-ornament.description: From Baro Ki'Teer: an exquisite ornament of unknown provenance to enhance your Orbiter.

dynar-s-leverian-mural.name: Dynar's Leverian Mural
dynar-s-leverian-mural.description: An elegant portrait of Dynar, the shadowed.

dyrncaul-chamfron.name: Dyrncaul Chamfron
dyrncaul-chamfron.description: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
